## Safety checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private media, or sensitive database/log content is included.
- [ ] Windows and Linux behavior remains supported.
- [ ] New platform behavior follows current official documentation and exposes limitations.
- [ ] UI changes reuse the current OpenRepurpose design system and include keyboard/responsive checks.
